Class PaperItemResources

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.paper.PaperItemResources
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemResources.Access
public final class PaperItemResources extends Object implements ItemResources.Access
Resources held by items on Paper (D32): what an item holds comes from its ResourceItem CraftEngine behaviors, the amounts live in its CraftEngine item data under minecraft:custom_data → machineengine.resources.<type>.

Methods that change an ItemStack change the given stack itself, whether it is a server stack (from an inventory) or a plain Bukkit one.
